falseSynonyms.zh: 騷擾不等於所有 discrimination harassment 是令人受辱、受威嚇或處於敵意環境的行為；它可屬歧視的一種形式，但範圍不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Harassment can be discriminatory, but it is a specific form of harmful conduct.

falseSynonyms.zh: 刻板印象不等於 discrimination stereotyping 是把固定特徵套在某群體；它可導致歧視，但不等於實際差別待遇。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Stereotyping is a belief pattern; discrimination is treatment or conduct.

falseSynonyms.zh: 種族主義不等於所有 discrimination racism 只涉及種族／族裔層面；discrimination 可以基於性別、年齡、殘疾等多種因素。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Racism is narrower than discrimination.

falseSynonyms.zh: 性別歧視／性別偏見不等於所有 discrimination sexism 聚焦性別；discrimination 的範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Sexism is one possible basis of discrimination, not a general synonym.

falseSynonyms.zh: 欺凌不等於 discrimination bullying 是持續欺壓或傷害；可以沒有任何群體／身份基礎。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Bullying may be unfair and harmful without being discriminatory.

falseSynonyms.zh: 偏袒不等於所有 discrimination favouritism 是偏愛某人；它可能造成不公平，但不一定涉及受保護特徵或群體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Favouritism can create unfairness without amounting to discrimination.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不平等不等於 discrimination inequality 是結果或狀態；discrimination 是可能造成不平等的行為／制度機制。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Inequality is an outcome or condition; discrimination is a possible cause.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 discriminate 是動詞；discrimination 是名詞。句法位置不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Discriminate is a verb; discrimination is a noun.
